test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct indirect narration of the following statement from the given alternatives:

Snigdha said, "What a beautiful day today is!"

options.text: Snigdha exclaimed that that day has been a very beautiful day.
Snigdha exclaimed that that day a very beautiful day was.
Snigdha exclaimed that day was a very beautiful day.
Snigdha exclaimed that that day was a very beautiful day.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Snigdha exclaimed that that day was a very beautiful day.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"What a beautiful day today is!" becomes "that day was a very beautiful day"**
 
 
• Exclamation is converted to a declarative sentence in indirect speech.
 
• Pronoun "today" changes to "that day" to reflect the perspective of indirect narration.
 
• Verb "is" changes to "was" to match the past tense required in reported speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Direct: "said"
 
• Converted to: "exclaimed" to convey the emotional expression of the original exclamation.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Indirect speech does not use quotation marks.
 
• The sentence is structured with proper tense and pronoun changes to reflect the indirect narration.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *Snigdha exclaimed that that day was a very beautiful day.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Snigdha exclaimed that that day has been a very beautiful day."

 
 
• Incorrect tense usage. "Has been" is present perfect, which does not match the past tense required in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Snigdha exclaimed that that day a very beautiful day was."
 
 
• Incorrect word order. The sentence structure is awkward and does not follow proper English grammar.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Snigdha exclaimed that day was a very beautiful day."
 
 
• Missing the pronoun "that" before "day," resulting in incomplete conversion.
